tax.text: Moore's campaign backs the Trump economic agenda of cutting taxes, including on tips, overtime and Social Security.
tax.quote: President Trump is building an economy that puts working families first beginning with cutting taxes on tips, overtime and Social Security.

safety.text: Moore's campaign emphasizes law and order and support for police.
safety.quote: Law enforcement knows that Barry has their back.

immigration.text: Moore calls for zero tolerance for illegal immigration and supports border enforcement and deportations.
immigration.quote: Barry believes there should be zero tolerance for illegal immigration.

guns.text: Moore defends gun rights, opposes red flag laws and restrictions on firearms.
guns.quote: Barry believes in the right to keep and bear arms – period.

abortion.text: Moore said elective abortion should not be allowed, consistent with Alabama law.
abortion.quote:
Under what circumstances should an elective abortion be allowed?
 None, as in Alabama law.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Moore's campaign opposes transgender women competing in women's sports.
gender.quote: Men have no business in women's sports – period.

health.text: Moore criticizes the Affordable Care Act and backs a system with more private choices and competition.
health.quote: The Affordable Care Act has failed to deliver on its promises, causing costs to skyrocket, limiting options, and weakening quality of care while becoming a magnet for fraud.

energy.text: Moore voted against the 2022 climate spending law, opposing its Green New Deal provisions.
energy.quote: Instead, it puts more weight on the backs of hard-working Americans through hefty tax increases on American pensions and more than 700,000 new audits for those making under $75,000 a year, all to provide billions in tax breaks for wealthy corporations to implement Green New Deal policies.

voting.text: Moore strongly opposed allowing people to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote:
People should be able to vote without photo identification.
 Strongly Disagree

schools.text: Wess says Alabama should maintain quality public education and describes public education as an engine of opportunity.
schools.quote: His education reflects a deep belief in the power of learning, Alabama institutions, and public education as engines of opportunity.
